coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 14 of 17 ground-truth variable items (82%, rounded), including consistent dataset splits, sequence and forecast lengths, cycle length, model type, input/output dimensions, RevIN use, batch size, synthetic-data parameters, normalization, cycle indexing, MSE, MAE, and loss-curve visualizations.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses AdamW rather than the specified Adam configuration, replaces 30 epochs with dataset-dependent epoch ranges, and does not specify the required single NVIDIA RTX 4090 with 24GB memory. Visualization coverage is incomplete: loss curves are included, but plots of learned cyclic patterns are not explicitly planned. Numerous additional ablations go beyond the ground-truth design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the conclusion describing a trained CycleNet capable of accurate forecasting and visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
